question.worked_solution:
To calculate $f(-4),$ we substitute $x=-4$ into the expression for $f(x).$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-4) & =12\cdot {2}^{-4} \\  & =12\cdot \frac{1}{{2}^{4}} \\  & =12\cdot \frac{1}{16} \\  & =\frac{12}{16} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
